servicesSummary: Kurdistan Regional Government Registrant provided advice on legal matters and policy-related matters to the foreign principal. These matters included advice to the foreign principal in relation to U.S. Government policies on Iraq and the Middle East. Such assistance included making contact with members of the Legislative Branch of the U.S. Government.
moneyExplanation: No verified receipts or expenditures have yet been extracted from this filing. The absence of an extracted amount does not mean no money moved.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total. Itemized financial rows require an exact known principal, real date, counterparty, purpose and amount. U.S. political contacts require an itemized principal/date/contact/method/purpose row. No payment to a politician or principal-specific share is inferred.
